title: 16S-V4V5 rRNA Metabarcoding PCR Protocol for NGS Illumina Sequencing
author: Sarah Romac
materials: PCR reactions are performed using the Taq polymerase Phusion High-Fidelity Master Mix with GC buffer (Thermofisher, Cat No F-532 L). This Taq has a good proof-reading and its buffer allows amplification of high GC templates. Keep the same annealing temperature as the one is used with the usual 16S-V4V5 primer set. First test each of your taggeg-primer sets on a positive and a negative control following steps 5, 6, 7 and 8. Then you can perform DNA sample amplification following next steps.

PCR products are quantified using the quantification kit: Quant-iT™ PicoGreen® dsDNA reagent *2000 assays* (Invitrogen, cat nb P7581) and a Fluorometer Plate readerFluorometer Plate reader, following the manufacturer's protocol. Quant-it Picogreen dsDNA kit.pdf

After the preparation of the Pooled Amplicons (and concentration if needed), the final concentration is checked by quantification using Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Invitrogen) with the kit Qubit 1x dsDNA HS Assay (Invitrogen, Thermofisher Scientific cat. No Q33230). MAN0019617_Qubit_1X_dsDNA_BR_Assay_UG.pdf
If possible, check the final Pooled Amplicons quality on a Bioanalyzer using the kit Agilent DNA 1000 (Agilent Technologies, Cat. No 5067-1504). G2938-90014_DNA1000Assay_KG.pdf

Sample loading and electrophoresis conditions : Prepare the loading samples : In a semi-skirted 96-wells PCR plate (like AB-0900 PCR plate), mix 5µL of each sample with 1µL of loading buffer 6x (Thermofisher Scientific, ref R0611). Place solidified gel in the proper orientation (electrophoresis occurs from cathode to anode). Load : - PCR products : 6µL ; - Smartladder 200 to 10 000 bp : 3µL ; (Eurogentec, ref MW-1700-10). Close the caster and connect it to the generator ( Bio-Rad, ref 1645050). Let run the electrophoresis at 110 V for 45 min.

steps.title: Prepare Tagged Primers
steps.instruction: Prepare and dilute the prokaryotic 16SV4V5 primer set (515fY- 926r) under a PCR hood.

substeps.instruction: Elute lyophilized tagged-primers (RP-Cartridge Gold purification from Eurogentec) at 100 µM using TE 1X sterile buffer.
Allow primers to dissolve for 15 min at room temperature, then short vortex and spin.
Prepare 10 µM working solutions by adding 10 µL of 100 µM stock primer to 90 µL of sterile molecular grade milliQ water in labeled 1.5mL microtubes.
Store stock primers and working solutions at -20°C.

steps.title: Set Up PCR Plate
steps.instruction: Organize the PCR reactions on a semi-skirted 96-well PCR plate (e.g., AB-0900).

substeps.instruction: Assign a unique tagged-MID-primer to each DNA sample.
Perform PCR reactions in triplicate for each DNA sample to ensure a minimum yield of 50 ng.
Include one positive control and one negative control for each PCR plate.

steps.title: Perform PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Prepare the Master Mix and dispense reactions according to sample type.

substeps.instruction: For environmental samples: Dispense 24 µL of tagged-MID-primer PCR mix per well under the hood, then add 1 µL of DNA template on the bench.

For strain samples: Dispense 21 µL of tagged-MID-primer PCR mix per well under the hood (reducing milliQ H2O in Master Mix), then add 4 µL of DNA template on the bench to achieve 5-10 ng in the MasterMix.
Set the PCR program to a minimum of 25 cycles and a maximum of 30 (or up to 32) to reduce chimera formation during the plateau phase.

steps.title: Verify PCR Product Quality
steps.instruction: Check PCR products using 1.2% agarose gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1.2% agarose gel: Mix 1.2g agarose (Interchim ref 31272L) in 100mL 0.5x TAE buffer (diluted from 10x Thermofisher ref 15558042), heat until dissolved, and add one drop of Ethidium Bromide (Eurobio ref GEPBET02AF).
Cast the gel using a Biorad tray (ref 1704484) and allow to solidify for 20 min.
Run electrophoresis and observe under UV light using an imager (e.g., ImageQuant LAZ4000).

Verify results: Negative control must not amplify; positive control must amplify; target bands should be 423 bp or 467 bp (depending on target) with no smear. Note: a second band 200 bp longer may indicate eukaryotes.
Store amplicons at -20°C until purification.

steps.title: Purify PCR Products
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR products using the NucleoSpin® PCR Clean-Up kit (Macherey-Nagel cat. nb 740609.50 or 740609.250).

substeps.instruction: Pool triplicate PCRs into a single labeled microtube.
Mix 1 volume of sample with 2 volumes of buffer NT and follow manufacturer instructions, except for elution.
Place the NucleoSpin PCR Clean-Up Column into a clean 1.5mL microtube.
Add 22 µL buffer NE preheated to 65°C directly onto the column and incubate for 5 min at 65°C.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 11,000 g.
Store purified products at -20°C or proceed to quantification.

steps.title: Prepare Pooled Amplicons
steps.instruction: Pool quantified amplicons at equimolar concentrations for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Calculate volumes to create a final 'Pooled Amplicons' tube containing 1 µg of equimolar amplicon pool in 30 µL (concentration >35 ng/µL).
If the final volume exceeds 30 µL (concentration <35 ng/µL), perform an additional concentration step using the NucleoSpin® PCR Clean-Up kit.
Store Pooled Amplicons at -80°C until shipment.

steps.title: Ship Samples
steps.instruction: Ship samples on dry ice to the designated platform.

substeps.instruction: For Fasteris SA: Ship Pooled Amplicons to Plan-les-Ouates, Switzerland. Include quotation number, order form, purchase order, and Pro Forma Invoice.
For Plateforme GeT-Biopuces: Ship pooled amplicon plates to Toulouse, France. Include sample file PCR1 (plate plan and amplicon size) and signed Miseq prestation file.
